max_support: Escalating Vireo Labs - embeddings stopped accepting writes after tenant transfer. Customer says search for their enterprise app is broken and mentioned renewal conversation next week.
rachel_cs: thanks for flagging. do we have an error sample or a contact?
max_support: getting 403s from embedding endpoint. sample from logs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"tenant mapping mismatch"}
```
max_support: contact is lucy@vireo.ai. transfer happened at 08:30 local, they reported failures at 09:05.
rachel_cs: mark this P0 for CS - blocks customer demo and ties to renewal. need a short comms note + owners assigned. also pause renewal nudges.
nora_sales: I can pause renewal emails now. if >2h unresolved, approve 2-week credit?
samuel_eng: likely tenant mapping mismatch on our side after transfer. short-term: manual tenant sync + cache purge for vireo-tenant-02. ETA 35m.
max_support: infra-bot: request manual tenant-sync for vireo-tenant-02 with external_id=vireo-ext-02
infra-bot: @samuel_eng request received; ticket INF-5333 created and assigned. change window: immediate.
samuel_eng: applying mapping and purging cache now. will post results.
samuel_eng: mapping applied, cache purged. test writes now return 200.
max_support: running verification in prod - embedding writes accepted and search results returned. Lucy confirmed demo page loads.
rachel_cs: drafting external message (short): "We're aware of an ingestion issue after your tenant transfer. Our engineers applied a fix and ingestion is restored. We'll monitor and follow up with a technical note and credit if needed." OK to send?
nora_sales: yes, concise. I'll handle billing note and loop legal for credit mechanics. owners: ENG=@samuel_eng, SUPPORT=@max_support, CS=@rachel_cs, SALES=@nora_sales.
infra-bot: INF-5333 updated: change executed, verification complete; awaiting billing note for closure. closing ETA: 48h.
max_support: closing thread for now - will reopen on any regression. :white_check_mark:
